quality.counterexample: An app using an external data backend can pass all browser persistence checks while violating instruction.md:9.
quality.suggested_fix: Escalate the shared browser-only policy conflict for an approved environment-side check, or document this requirement as unmeasured; do not alter the frozen template or require source reading in current prompts.

quality.evidence: hireops_rules.md:54-56 leaves UI shape/routes open; functional judge.toml criteria use public outcomes and seed values.

functional judge.toml hro_accounts bundles 7 logins in one binary 0.5; hro_revision_roles bundles 5 allowed and 2 denied actors in one binary 1.0; hro_anon_read bundles all read families. hro_tier bundles all nine tier/band pairs; one missing pair erases all correct authority decisions.
quality.counterexample: One broken Approver revision zeros hro_revision_roles despite working Recruiter and Finance revisions; one failed login zeros six working accounts. A tier-1 approver that correctly handles Band I and II but mishandles only III loses the whole authority-matrix credit.
quality.suggested_fix: Split separately useful role/account outcomes into independently scored criteria while sharing setup.
